# `forge` command reference

<!-- generated by `forge docs`; do not edit. -->

Generated by `forge docs` from the command tree and the prompt frontmatter; do not edit. Run `forge docs` to regenerate it and `forge docs --check` to verify it.

```text
forge [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Coordinate several people and AI agents working in parallel on one GitHub repository.

## Global options

Global options go before the command (`forge --json status`). `--json`, `--agent`, `--repo`, `--verbose`, `-v`, `--yes`, `-y` are also accepted after it (`forge status --json`).

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--version`, `-V` | flag | no | - | Show the Forge version and exit. |
| `--json` | flag | no | - | Print one JSON envelope on stdout (ADR 0004). |
| `--agent` | str | no | - | Active agent id from the profile. Env: `FORGE_AGENT`. |
| `--repo` | path | no | - | Path to the repository (default: current directory). |
| `--verbose`, `-v` | flag | no | - | Print more detail. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag | no | - | Answer yes to confirmations. |

Every command also accepts `--help`. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 agent action, 3 nothing available, 4 escalation, 5 precondition (spec §16).

<a id="forge-next"></a>

### `forge next`

```text
forge next [OPTIONS]
```

Select and claim a task (spec §8.1).

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--task` | str | no | - | Claim this task only: M1-T07, #42 or 42. |
| `--reclaim` | flag | no | - | Also take over stale claims. |
| `--any-tier` | flag | no | - | Include tasks whose tier the agent cannot serve. |
| `--no-worktree` | flag | no | - | Check the branch out here instead of in a worktree. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | - | Print the ordered candidates; push nothing. |
| `--delegation` | choice | no | - | Delegation mode for this task (saved locally until release or handoff): off, auto or on. Choices: `off`, `auto`, `on`. |

## Prompts

| Prompt | Description | Args | Roles |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `setup` | Check this machine, create or update your personal profile, and run the project setup | `[--check]` | dev, lead |
| `configure` | Fill the project's config, team and zones from the codebase, validate them and open a PR | `[--update]` | lead |
| `plan` | Turn a project spec into a roadmap, or a milestone's specs into a validated task plan, and open a PR | `roadmap <spec-file> \| <milestone> [--update] [--agent <id>]` | lead |
| `architect` | Write or update a milestone's architecture and the system overview, validate them and open a PR | `<milestone> [--update]` | lead |
| `next` | Pick and claim the next available task, then load its context | `[task-id] [--reclaim] [--agent <id>]` | dev |
| `dev` | Implement the current task inside its zones, with tests, small commits and heartbeats | `[--solo\|--delegate]` | dev |
| `sync` | Rebase the current task on the default branch, resolve conflicts safely and push | `[--abort]` | dev |
| `ship` | Sync, run the checks, and open or update the task's pull request | `[--draft]` | dev |
| `review` | Review a task's pull request against its acceptance criteria, zones, contracts and tests | `<pr-number> [--force]` | dev, lead |
| `status` | Show where you, the team and the milestone stand, and suggest the next action | `[--me] [--milestone <id>]` | dev, lead |
| `handoff` | Write a handoff note and pass the current task to another person, account or provider | - | dev |
| `release` | Release a finished milestone in two steps, a changelog PR and then a tag with a GitHub release | `<milestone> [--version <x.y.z>]` | lead |
